subject: Vespera multi-year advance purchase discussion - structure and safety net
messages:
From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@vespera.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring multi-year advance purchase options for Vespera

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our platform traffic is ramping faster than forecast and procurement is asking us to get better unit economics in place if we lock in capacity. We have two scenarios we care about: a 24‑month advance purchase and a 36‑month advance purchase. Primary asks: predictable per-token price, a clear ramp schedule tied to committed units, and an annual true‑up (avoid retro clawbacks that surprise OSS/finance).

Rough numbers: current monthly consumption ~ 14M tokens/month with 35% expected growth year‑over‑year. We can provide a committed schedule but need help shaping the discount ladder so C-suite can sign off. Procurement timeline: would like a negotiated term and PO by mid‑May.

Attached is a simple usage model we built so you can see the cadence. Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Amy
Head of Platform Ops
Vespera Analytics
[Attachment: vespera_usage_model.csv]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@vespera.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year advance purchase options for Vespera

Amy —

Appreciate the model, that helps. High-level we can support both 24 and 36 month advance purchase structures. Initial, non-binding outline below — I put Markus and Kim on to confirm capacity/SLA and legal / finance checks.

- 24 months: 22% off list for a full upfront prepay, phased consumption schedule (60% year1, 100% year2) with an annual true‑up (no retro clawback beyond annual true‑up).
- 36 months: 26% off list for full upfront prepay, phased consumption schedule (50% year1, 85% year2, 100% year3) with annual true‑up.
- Safety net: if actual consumption falls below 70% of committed in any year, we do an annual true‑up and offer credit vs cash clawback.
- Onboarding credit: one‑time $25k onboarding credit for custom integration (vs deeper recurring discount).

I attached a quick spreadsheet with assumed token bands and illustrative pricing. This is something we can firm up after a short internal approval. Would you be comfortable if I come back with a formal offer by EOD Wednesday?

Best,
Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_pricing_v1.xlsx]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exploring multi-year advance purchase options for Vespera — approval path

Team —

Quick internal note on Vespera (DEAL-8423). Ben's draft above is reasonable but we need to limit downside and preserve unit economics. Key points:

- The 26% for 36m is marketable but eats into margin if we accommodate large year1 usage above committed. We should lock a hard cap on the maximum token band eligible for the deepest discount — e.g., first 24M tokens/month get discount, overage billed at a slightly higher overage rate.
- True‑up mechanics: annual true‑up with credits only is preferred (no cash clawbacks) but legal must scope language to avoid open ended exposure.
- Finance ask: get a revenue recognition note — advanced payment needs to be amortized; larger credits (onboarding) reduce recognized revenue. Need signoff from Finance for offers > 24% aggregate discount.

Can we approve up to 22% for 24m and 25% for 36m from Sales? Anything above requires CRO signoff. If Marissa signs off I will draft the customer offer and loop Legal.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exploring multi-year advance purchase options for Vespera — approval path

Markus / Ben —

I can sign off on the following conditional approvals:

- 24mo: up to 22% discount on the committed bands (with the onboarding credit as Ben proposed).
- 36mo: up to 25% discount if we include the safety net credit approach (annual true‑up credits only) and cap the deepest discount to the committed baseline (first 24M tokens/month).

Conditions: legal to include explicit true‑up language limiting retrospective exposure to the annual true‑up window; finance to confirm revenue recognition timeline for the prepay and the onboarding credit; agreements to include a clause for capacity prioritization during demand spikes. If Legal/Finance push back on the wording, escalate to CRO.

Attaching a short memo for the file. Once Legal approves language I give Ben the green light to present the formal offer.

-Marissa
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signoff_memo.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@vespera.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Formal offer: Vespera multi-year advance purchase (finalized)

Hi Amy —

Thanks for your patience while we routed approvals. Per internal signoffs, here is the formal, conditional offer for Vespera: 

- 24 months (Full upfront prepay): 22% discount applied to committed bands. Phased consumption: 60% year1, 100% year2. Annual true‑up (credits only) at contract anniversary. Onboarding: $25,000 one‑time credit.
- 36 months (Full upfront prepay): 25% discount applied to committed bands (deepest discount capped to baseline committed volume — first 24M tokens/month). Phased consumption: 50% year1, 85% year2, 100% year3. Annual true‑up (credits only).

Operational notes: capacity prioritization during constrained periods for committed customers; overage rate will be published in the SOW and billed monthly. Legal will propose language to ensure the true‑up window is the only retroactive reconciliation.

If that works, I'll circulate the DocuSign packet (SOW + MSA redline) and we can align on PO timing. Link to proposed DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-VESEPRA-8423

Would you like a short call tomorrow to walk through the ramp assumptions and the true‑up mechanics?

Best,
Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@vespera.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vespera.ai
Date: 2027-05-05T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Formal offer: Vespera multi-year advance purchase (finalized)

Ben —

Thanks — this is close to what we need. Procurement has reviewed and prefers the 36mo structure if you can commit to the capped deepest discount on baseline and the credits‑only true‑up. We will sign the DocuSign once the SOW has the explicit annual true‑up language and the onboarding credit is listed as a separate line item.

Please send the DocuSign + SoW and I will loop Legal on our side. Targeting PO submission by 2027‑05‑12. Happy to take a 20 minute call tomorrow at 10:00 PT to finalize wording.

Appreciate the quick routing,
Amy
Head of Platform Ops
Vespera Analytics
